sloka: क्रुद्धः सौमित्रिरुत्पत्य तूणादाक्षिप्य सायकम्।पुरस्तादतिकायस्य विचकर्ष महद्धनुः ।। ६.७१.४७ ।।
transliteration: kruddhaḥ saumitrirutpatya tūṇādākṣipya sāyakam।purastādatikāyasya vicakarṣa mahaddhanuḥ ।। 6.71.47 ।।

translations.english: Furious Saumithri, springing up, took up his arrow from the quiver, stretching to full length before he discharged the arrow.
